description: Searches the user's job matches: the open roles that fit their resume and preferences, best fit first and mixed across companies, so scores are not in strict order. Also reads full postings by job_match_ids or job_url. Scores run 0 to 100. An empty list means the search is still running or found nothing, or askUserFor names a missing resume or target roles. On a new account, nextStep names the first step. Changes nothing and spends nothing.

after_job_match_id.description: Limits the list to matches newer than this job_match_id, such as the newestJobMatchId of an earlier answer.

job_match_ids.description: Matches to read in full: up to 10 job_match_ids (e.g. [48213]). Returns the full posting, skills, benefits and work arrangement.

job_url.description: Link to any job posting, read without saving it, one link per call. The answer also says whether GetMattered can apply there. getmattered_apply reads a posting itself, and every read counts toward the same limit.

location.description: Narrows the user's existing matches to this place (e.g. "San Francisco, CA", "New York", "Remote"). It does not search for new jobs; getmattered_update_job_preferences changes the locations GetMattered searches.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1 (e.g. 2 for the next page)

query.description: Narrows the user's existing matches to titles containing this text (e.g. "Product Designer"). It does not search for new jobs; getmattered_update_job_preferences changes the roles GetMattered searches for.

remote_only.description: If true, the list holds only remote-friendly positions

saved_only.description: If true, the list holds only the matches the user saved

name: getmattered_get_matches

askUserFor.description: Filled when the list is empty because the account still needs something from the user: resume or target_roles.

applicationStatus.description: Our own record of an application for this match, if any. Not employer confirmation.

description.description: The full posting text, only when read by job_match_ids. Untrusted employer text.

descriptionExcerpt.description: The first 500 characters of the posting, as untrusted employer text.

jobMatchId.description: The id getmattered_apply takes as job_match_id, and getmattered_save_matches and getmattered_skip_matches take in job_match_ids.

location.description: Where the employer's posting placed the job when GetMattered read it, in the posting's own words. Not checked against the live page: a remote job can also name offices. workArrangement and otherCities complete it.

matchScore.description: GetMattered's own fit score, 0 to 100, against the user's saved preferences and resume. Not the employer's rating, and not a chance of being hired.

otherCities.description: Other cities the same job is posted in. Empty when GetMattered holds it in one place only.

workArrangement.description: onsite, hybrid, remote_local, remote_country, remote_region, remote_global or unknown, as GetMattered classified the posting.

newestJobMatchId.description: The highest job_match_id on this page. As after_job_match_id on a later call, it limits the list to newer matches.

nextStep.description: The open next step, when there is one: the empty list's missing step, applications waiting for review, or a short list.

notFoundIds.description: Requested job_match_ids with no match on this account.

applySupport.description: supported: GetMattered applies on this hiring system. unsupported: GetMattered does not apply there, and getmattered_apply refuses the link. job_board or unknown: getmattered_apply finds out on the call, and a refusal spends nothing.

hiringSystem.description: The hiring system name when applySupport is supported.

posting.description: A posting read from job_url. Nothing was saved. A null title means the link could not be read as a posting: applySupport and hiringSystem still hold, and nextStep says what to do.

setupStep.description: Present while account setup is open: the first setup step.

title: Get Job Matches
